obligations.expected_behavior: For the complete atomic-obligation inventory, establish bidirectional Exact Cover for every atomic obligation.
forbidden_result: Any atomic obligation lacks Exact Cover in either direction.
obligations.observable_result: The evaluated coverage relation shows 100% bidirectional Exact Cover across the atomic-obligation inventory.
obligations.state_after: Every atomic obligation is covered in both directions by the Exact Cover relation.
obligations.state_before: Bidirectional Exact Cover for the complete atomic-obligation inventory has not yet been established as complete.
obligations.subject: Atomic-obligation inventory
obligations.trigger: When the SM-1 atomic-obligation coverage is evaluated.

obligations.expected_behavior: Provide the required witnesses for every atomic obligation in the inventory.
forbidden_result: Any atomic obligation is missing a required witness.
Witness coverage is incomplete or only partial.
obligations.observable_result: The evaluation confirms required-witness coverage for 100% of atomic obligations.
obligations.state_after: Every atomic obligation has its required witnesses.
obligations.state_before: Required-witness completeness for the atomic-obligation inventory has not yet been established as complete.
obligations.subject: Required witnesses for atomic obligations
obligations.trigger: When the SM-1 witness completeness is evaluated.

obligations.expected_behavior: Ensure that no orphan atomic obligations remain in the evaluated inventory.
forbidden_result: One or more atomic obligations are orphaned.
The orphan count is greater than zero.
obligations.observable_result: The evaluation reports an orphan count of zero.
obligations.state_after: The atomic-obligation inventory contains zero orphans.
obligations.state_before: A zero-orphan result has not yet been established for the atomic-obligation inventory.
obligations.subject: Orphan status of atomic obligations
obligations.trigger: When the SM-1 inventory integrity is evaluated.
